report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.book.shared_model. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh, read the complete claim and all nine associated tests, and recaptured all previous dependencies: book/spec fixtures, book.rs, workspace.rs, check.rs, main.rs, workspace test, CI workflow, correspondence.rs and book/anchors.rs. Compared every fragment by path/selector and both association metadata sets. The sole change is an implementation_references association comment in spec.rs. All behavior, tests, claim, helpers, TODO text and metadata are unchanged; no fragments were removed. This actual delta was assessed against the full prior findings below.

Three implementation entries are accounted for: SpecIndex::load_workspace, xtask orphan checking and the explicit TODO region. The shared loader uses configured source root/SUMMARY, includes modeled Sage chapters and nearest-owned companion Markdown under the canonical Crates landing, and assigns canonical identities/provenance through shared chapter insertion. Generated anchor pages are excluded as definitions; omitted Design Markdown and model chapters diagnose errors. Captured book.rs and anchors.rs use that inventory to render chapters/rule pages; check.rs uses the same loader and CorrespondenceIndex with Cargo-owned discovery. Common workspace helpers supply model roots and ownership. CLI main invokes shared check, xtask CI invokes the CLI and workspace tests, the captured workflow invokes xtask ci test, and tests/workspace.rs applies sage_meta::check to the repository. No book-rule namespace exemption exists. These are wiring/source observations, not CI execution.

Eight ordinary tests provide substantive assertions. canonical_inventory_uses_configured_chapters_and_local_names checks exact normative keys, README context and document count. companion_guides_use_the_nearest_enclosing_crate_in_inventory_and_book compares index membership with actual book source_path/parent_names for nested demo/support guides. generated_crate_guides_are_canonical_and_link_to_rendered_sage_chapters checks companion definition, exact rewritten link, missing target rejection and omitted model diagnosis after removing the landing. noncanonical_crates_chapters_do_not_activate_generated_sources checks an alternative crates.md does not activate model/guide publication and both omissions diagnose. nonnormative_book_chapters_reference_rules_without_defining_them checks one definition/two references, rendered navigation and dangling historical reference errors. only_owned_crate_guides_are_automatically_published distinguishes owned, explicitly listed and unowned sources with exact inclusion/exclusion and a single omission error. unpublished_rule_sources_do_not_silently_disappear checks the orphan Design source diagnostic. xtask's orphan_check_uses_generated_chapters_and_rejects_unpublished_sources accepts generated guides, rejects non-Design orphans/unowned guides and missing landing publication, and excludes still-published guides from error text. Captured fixtures use actual files and preprocessing.

The ninth test and third implementation entry, TODO generation_and_checking_share_the_design_inventory, preserve incomplete full plugin/check/render and generated-copy parity coverage. The ordinary cases establish ownership/omission behavior but do not compare every identity/provenance/correspondence record across all consumers or prove arbitrary contributing plugins. Completion requires a representative chapter-contributing plugin fixture and generation/CLI/library/re-indexed-copy comparisons, including the book's own rules and negative omissions. The empty TODO is not treated as passing behavioral evidence. No N/A entries exist.

All requirements are supported by current shared mechanisms and concrete assertions or remain explicitly deferred in that TODO. No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed; executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. No requested edits.
